_note: Transposed from GoogleInteractionsAdapter.parseResponse. NOT FULLY SELF-CONTAINED: the hand-written parser also populates the adapter's `toolCallNames` map, which buildRequest later reads to name a tool RESULT (interactions.ts:145). That is request-side state, not part of the response, so it cannot live in a spec. Whoever switches this adapter to the interpreter must keep feeding that map -- iterating result.toolCalls after the build does it -- or tool results go out with an empty name.

items._note: The step_list flattened. A model_output step carries a content[] of typed parts; any other step stands for itself. Collect walks this rather than the raw response, because the items are not a field of it.
